beaches.name: Agios Nikolaos, Anavyssos
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported across a small pebble cove 4.5 km southeast of Saronida. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2017 to 2023 describing the beach as fully nudist; Greek press listicles from 2024 and 2025 call it a cove exclusively for nudists. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Althea hotel beach (Mavro Lithari)
beaches.summary: Reports of nude bathing at this beach below an abandoned hotel conflict. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2017 to 2023: nudist-friendly through 2022, but a June 2023 report finds almost no nudists among textile bathers; hotel building works restarted in 2020 and stopped by 2022. A Greek press article names the adjacent Mavro Lithari area as a nudist alternative.
